gloss: to be envious; to take offense

definitions.gloss: to be envious; to take a twisted view; to feel bitter
definitions.explanation: To view things with jealousy or resentment, often interpreting neutral situations negatively due to a sense of inferiority or perceived unfairness.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{僻|ひが}むな⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't be so bitter about it.

examples.japanese: {僻|ひが}んだ⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧はやめた⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: You should stop looking at things with such a jaundiced eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幸|しあわ}せそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧、つい{僻|ひが}んでしまう。
examples.english: Everyone around me seems happy, so I can't help feeling envious.

notes:
Describes a psychological tendency to interpret things through a lens of jealousy, resentment, or self-pity. Unlike simple envy, {僻|ひが}む implies a distorted, negative perspective — the person assumes others are looking down on them or that the world is unfair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {僻|ひが}んだ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at with envious/jaundiced eyes
- {僻|ひが}んだ⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧: a twisted/bitter perspective
- {僻|ひが}み⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧: a jealous/twisted disposition
- {僻|ひが}み⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: prone to envy/bitterness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {妬|ねた}む: to be jealous of — focuses on jealousy of someone's success or possessions
- ⟦{羨|うらや}む→羨む：01903_urayamu⟧: to envy — lighter and more neutral; can be positive ("I envy your talent")
- {僻|ひが}む is more self-pitying and negative than either; it implies a warped worldview
